title: Meet African penguins at the Florida Aquarium
description: The Florida Aquarium’s Penguin Encounter brings a small group near its African penguins with animal-care staff. Watch how the birds move and interact, ask about their care, and learn about conservation work for a species facing serious threats. The encounter adds a personal scale to what you see later in the wider aquarium.
teaser: Meet African penguins with the people who care for them.
goodToKnow: The encounter has its own participation rules and fee in addition to admission; confirm both before booking.
whyItMightDelightYou: A close view reveals each bird’s own behavior beyond the familiar penguin silhouette.
